notes_for_editor: Thin record: two map pages only. The brief's status 'standing' is not confirmed by any source; OpenStreetMap only maps a historic tower, undated. No NHLR, FFLOS or firelookout.ca entry for this summit appears in the local data. Do not confuse with ca-bc-windy-joe (Windy Joe Lookout, Manning Park). An AllTrails listing and a search snippet say the summit has a fire lookout, but the AllTrails page returned HTTP 403 and is not cited. Read budget overran by one page (seven reads, two searches). Nothing verified on the ground.
